notes.title: PATCH NOTES #2
notes.notes:
Good news everyone ːsteamhappyː

The game achievements and leaderboard have become available! And your rating is saved when you complete the game.
If you've already completed the game before this patch, press the 'Update Score' button as shown in the picture:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32569250/59d30a5aef95e4c2ef57a059ea16079db11b0db1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES #1
notes.notes:
Good news everyone!

The problem with the player being pressed down by the platform is solved. ːsteamhappyː
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32569250/1d2f28bf065f780a40d56acfee05559ea9ac7bf7.jpg[/img]
